title: Derived transport of coherent comparison squares
statement: Given an underived ComparisonSquareComponent equation for the canonical module comparison data over a commutative ring, the exact derived and left-derived pullback constructions transport it to the bounded-below comparison_square equation.

proof.text: Assemble the chosen Cartesian square. Component extensionality gives equality of its two ordinary paths using the generic comparisonSquarePaths_eq lemma. The two independent normalization theorems identify the displayed derived paths with the derived images of those ordinary paths, conjugated by common source and target composition factors. Apply comparisonSquareDerivedPath to the ordinary path equality by congruence, combine the two independent HEq normalizations with that equality, and convert the resulting HEq of the original components to their homogeneous equality.

proof_origin.place: Expanded comparison-square step 4: ordinary path extensionality, separate normalization of each derived path, and equality transport

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_square_of_component
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y' Y : Scheme.{u}} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Y'}
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (M : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)))
    (hcomp : ∀ F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ),
      ComparisonSquareComponent
        (comparisonSquareData (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g' f' f g
          { toCommSq := sq.toCommSq
            isoPullback := sq.isoPullback
            hom_fst := sq.isoPullback_hom_fst
            hom_snd := sq.isoPullback_hom_snd }) F) :
    (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ D(ν^*(X')[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).map
        ((Etale.pullbackSquareComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).hom.app M) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso g' Λ).hom.app
        (D+(Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj M) ≫
      L(ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso f Λ).hom.app M) =
    (leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso f' Λ).hom.app
        (D+(Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj M) ≫
      L(ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').map
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarComparisonIso g Λ).hom.app M) ≫
      (leftDerivedUpperStarSquareIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙ D(ν^*(Y)[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ])).obj M)
